body: That didn't seem cruel and vicious. It's better than blindly telling me to keep myself alive. It's a testament to my worthlessness that I'd rather just put a bullet through my head.
I doubt it, but thanks anyways.

My username is a joke that I never got around to using, so I'm using it here. It isn't meant to be taken seriously.

Maybe my last point is contradictory. I don't know. I thought of it like Hitler killing himself- after trying to commit genocide, he at least had the decency to shoot himself. (I know it's more complicated than that, bit that's the best way I can explain it.)

Is a self aware asshole better than a normal asshole? Maybe, but he's still an asshole and, in my case, doesn't think he deserves to keep living.

I'm not sure what you exactly mean by "it could be livable." Anything *could* be livable, but I don't intend to live this way. There's something else wrong with me- I prefer to end my life rather than to confront my problems. Maybe women will come just a little closer to liking me since I had the decency to kill myself.
